whatThisIs: The precondition every route raster verdict in raster-receipts/ depends on. The central workflow makes its family matrix depend on the canary job for exactly this reason: a batch of green verdicts from a runner that cannot render is worse than a red batch.
ranWhere: the build container for lane fable/routeaccept, not a GitHub-hosted runner
notAWorkflowRun: This is not a run of .github/workflows/rcap-packet-raster-acceptance-batch.yml. There is no workflowRunId, no jobId and no uploaded receipt artifact. It is the same tool (scripts/rcap-raster-batch.mjs), the same canary (scripts/rcap-raster-canary.mjs), the same measurements and the same refusals, executed locally against a lane-local manifest.
howToReproduceCentrally: dispatch the workflow with commit_sha set to this branch commit and raster_manifest_path set to data/rcap-grade-a/route-artifact-acceptance/ROUTE_ARTIFACT_RASTER_QUEUE.json; RASTER_QUEUE.json is not involved and is not modified
